description: Source file for AVInput plugin handling HDMI and composite input management, including event handling, device control, and JSON-RPC methods.

classes.name: AVInput
classes.description: Main class implementing AVInput plugin functionalities, including device control, event handling, and JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers event handlers and methods.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: getTypeOfInput
methods.description: Converts input type string to internal constant (HDMI or COMPOSITE).

methods.name: endpoint_numberOfInputs
methods.description: JSON-RPC method to get number of input ports.

methods.name: endpoint_currentVideoMode
methods.description: JSON-RPC method to get current video mode.

methods.name: startInput
methods.description: Starts input on specified port and type.

methods.name: stopInput
methods.description: Stops input on specified port and type.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Sets video rectangle for input.

methods.name: getInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of input devices for HDMI or composite.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Writes EDID data to a port.

methods.name: readEDID
methods.description: Reads EDID data from a port.

methods.name: getSPD
methods.description: Retrieves SPD data for a port.

methods.name: getRawSPD
methods.description: Retrieves raw SPD data for a port.

methods.name: setMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets audio mixer levels.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set Allm support in EDID for a port.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get Allm support status from EDID for a port.

methods.name: setEdidVersionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to set EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getHdmiVersionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get HDMI version capability.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getEdidVersionWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper to get EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Retrieves EDID version for a port.
